evals.prompt: Clean up this repo — find what's dead, what's risky, what we can retire.
evals.expected_output: clean-project runs in audit mode, records findings in the root optimizeproject.md, and changes nothing else.
expectations: Creates or updates the root optimizeproject.md with sequential CP IDs
First line of the reply is Outcome: followed by clean, findings, or could-not-assess
Deletes, moves, or edits no project file other than the register
Every retirement claim cites evidence beyond file age or a single grep

evals.prompt: Reorganize the docs folder so it's easier to navigate.
evals.expected_output: clean-project does not fire; the request is routed to directory-cleanup.
expectations: Runs no usage or security audit

evals.prompt: Delete the local branches whose remotes are gone.
evals.expected_output: clean-project does not fire; the request is routed to git-clean-gone-branches.
expectations: Runs no cleanup audit and creates no register

evals.prompt: Run clean-project audit on ./vendor-mirror — it is a submodule with no checkout here.
evals.expected_output: The audit reports Outcome: could-not-assess because no baseline can be established, and writes nothing.
expectations: States that the baseline is missing because the submodule has no checkout
Writes no register for the unidentified repository root

evals.prompt: Apply CP-0003 (delete legacy/export.py). Note: that file changed yesterday.
evals.expected_output: CP-0003 is held for renewed approval because the reviewed state changed; nothing is applied or committed.
expectations: Holds CP-0003 for renewed approval because the file changed after review
Applies no other finding or change
Verification lists the checks that were not run
